pages.title: Order a home radon gas test kit

components.content: Use this service to order a radon gas test kit for a property in the UK and the Isle of Man.</br></br>The radon gas test kit measures the level of radon in your property over a period of three months. The results will show if the radon level is above the Action Level or not as advised by the UK Health Security Agency. If your result is above the Action Level, you should take steps to reduce it.
The Action Level for radon in homes is 200 becquerels per cubic metre (Bq m<sup>-3</sup>). A becquerel is a measure of radioactivity.
You may wish to use the Target Level of 100 Bq m<sup>-3</sup> if there are smokers or ex-smokers living in the property as there is a greater risk to their health.

A test kit costs £52.80 (including VAT).

Your kit includes:

  • 2 detectors, one for the living area and the other for the bedroom
  • detector placement instructions
  • a pre-paid envelope, to return the detector three months later
After three months you will return the kit and receive a report showing the radon level at your address and advice on whether you need to take remedial action.
Before you start
Ordering a kit takes around 5 minutes. It may take up to 10 working days for the kit to be delivered.
To review:

• if you are a landlord, you have a duty of Care under the Housing Act (2004) to provide a safe home - you can find more information on the need for action with regards to radon gas defined by the Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS)
  • if your property's radon level has been measure before using UKHSA, you may be eligible for a free retest - you will be asked your name, address, and the method of remediaton you have used to determine your eligibility
  • if you would like 20 or more radon detectors, or are a public sector organisation, contact us as discounts may be available
The test will not be valid if:

• any building work is planned during the testing period that disrupts normal living conditions, or changes the way air moves through the property
  • the property is empty for more than 2 weeks during the test
  • the people living in the property change during the test
This is because the way a home is used can affect radon levels. For example, how often windows and doors are opened, or how the home is heated.
You'll need your:

• a valid email address
  • a postal delivery address in the UK or Isle of Man
  • your measurement address
  • your payment details
